method: Full main/panel source read and pinned Git blobs checked. Static UI state/control-flow review; no rendered-browser claim.
findings: Status marks complete solely on toProcess===0. Failed-playlist completion state from v3 therefore selects complete status; playlists with duplicates[] and empty status are filtered out. No incomplete/error aggregate shown in this component.

totalDuplicates is forced0 when playlist list is empty, ignoring saved-track duplicates even if present. Thus zero-owned-playlist library can select no-duplicates summary while saved-track duplicate list remains rendered. Source-only UI contradiction, no screenshot/runtime reproduction.

Saved-track removal awaits early-resolving method reproduced in v1, then clears duplicates and assigns removed status and success analytics. The outer list item itself renders only while duplicates.length>0, so success badge disappears with list.

Playlist delete errors only optionally report to Raven; no status or error message update. Buttons have no in-flight disable/progress flag, allowing repeated clicks in source flow; concurrent API behavior unexecuted.

componentDidMount invokes process promise without awaiting/catching and stores no cancellation/unsubscribe handle. Listener may update component after unmount; actual React runtime warning/resource effects unqualified.

Translations injected via dangerouslySetInnerHTML for completed summary; constant strong wrappers supplied but translation sources not yet reviewed. No injection vulnerability inferred without provenance/configuration evidence.
limits: No browser render, fullapp/runtime/network or production change. pHash/ASAN deferred.
